home.title: Draw & Guess
home.description: Play Draw & Guess online with friends. Create a room instantly, draw in real time, and guess words together on mobile or desktop.
home.heroCopy: A fast browser party game for groups. Start a room in seconds, share the link, and play real-time drawing rounds without installing anything.
home.hintCreate: Create a new room and invite friends
home.hintJoin: Enter room ID to join the game

features.title: Why play Draw & Guess online
features.intro: This version is built for quick party sessions, simple sharing, and smooth browser play across devices.
features.instantText: Create a room in one step, send the link, and let friends join without accounts or downloads.
features.socialText: Players take turns drawing while everyone else guesses in chat, with scoring and round flow handled automatically.
features.mobileText: The UI is optimized for touch and small screens while still working well for desktop group play.

how.title: How the game works
how.intro: The flow stays simple so new players can join a room and understand the rules immediately.
how.step1Text: Enter a nickname, create a room, or paste a room ID to jump into an existing game with friends.
how.step2Title: Draw when it is your turn
how.step2Text: One player becomes the drawer, gets the secret word, and uses the canvas tools to communicate the idea visually.
how.step3Title: Guess in chat and score points
how.step3Text: Other players type guesses in chat. Correct guesses score points, and the game rotates until everyone has drawn.

rules.title: Game Rules
rules.process1: 1. Players take turns drawing while others guess.
rules.process2: 2. Each round lasts 75s. Ends when all guess correctly or time is up.
rules.process3: 3. Game ends after everyone has drawn once.
rules.notice1: • No writing words, pinyin, or direct hints.
rules.notice2: • Type guesses in the chat box.

what.question: What is Draw & Guess?
what.answer: Draw & Guess is a browser-based multiplayer drawing and guessing game where one player draws and others guess through chat.

download.question: Do players need to download anything?
download.answer: No. Players can open the room in a browser and start playing without installing an app.

friends.question: Can I play with friends privately?
friends.answer: Yes. Create a room, share the link or room ID, and let invited players join directly.

mobile.question: Does it work on mobile?
mobile.answer: Yes. The interface is designed to support mobile screens while remaining usable on desktop.

private.question: Do I need an account?
private.answer: No account is required for the current web experience. Players join with a nickname and room ID.

ai.question: What are AI reference images for?
ai.answer: The drawer can request reference images to get visual inspiration for the current word without leaving the game.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.introText: This policy applies to the DrawAndGuess web game, including room play, chat, drawing sync, sharing, and reference-image features. You can play without creating an account.
privacy.dataCollectionText: To keep the game working and stable, we process:
privacy.dataPoint1: Basic info such as nickname, room ID, and language preference
privacy.dataPoint2: Gameplay data such as strokes, chat messages, round scores, and room state
privacy.dataPoint3: Technical data such as IP address, browser type, and access time
privacy.dataPoint4: Traffic metrics such as page visits and basic usage events
privacy.dataUsageText: We only use data for service operation and improvement:
privacy.dataUsagePoint1: Run real-time multiplayer sessions and synchronize game state
privacy.dataUsagePoint2: Troubleshoot issues, prevent abuse, and improve performance
privacy.dataUsagePoint3: Understand feature usage and prioritize product iteration
privacy.cookiesText: We use browser storage (for example, to remember language preference) and may use analytics-related cookies to measure site usage.
privacy.thirdPartyText: Some features rely on external services:
privacy.thirdPartyPoint1: Google Analytics: site traffic and basic behavior analytics (if enabled)
privacy.thirdPartyPoint2: DeepSeek API: trending word generation on the server side
privacy.thirdPartyPoint3: Image search proxy: AI reference image display
privacy.retentionText: Real-time room data is primarily stored in server memory and is cleared when a room becomes empty. It is also reset on server restart. Analytics data may be retained for operations analysis.
privacy.rightsText: You can stop using the service at any time by leaving the page. If you want to request access, update, or deletion of relevant data, please contact us via the Contact page.

about.title: About Us
about.missionText: DrawAndGuess is a lightweight real-time multiplayer drawing game designed for quick starts and instant social interaction.
about.storyText: The current version includes room creation/joining, real-time drawing sync, chat guessing, round scoring, room sharing, AI reference images, and bilingual support (English/Chinese).
about.teamText: We focus on mobile-first usability, low-latency synchronization, and clear game rules that are easy to learn.
about.roadmapText: We will continue improving gameplay stability, anti-abuse controls, internationalization, and live-ops features for global players.
